## About
BMS Racing Engines is an automotive machine shop in Plymouth Meeting, run by Vince Iacavino and Josh Debickes. Vince and Josh met studying Motorsports Technology at Luzerne County Community College, then spent years in dyno rooms and race shops, including work with Penske Racing.
BMS started in a one-car garage, on nights and weekends. Today we build all types of race engines, from road race and sprint cars to drag, pro street and marine, and we build import combinations too, including Hondas, Subarus and Nissans.
Whether you need a set of heads freshened up or a full engine package designed from scratch, give us a call. We're rated 4.8 from 40 Google reviews, and we'd like to hear what you're working on.

## Services
- Cylinder head work: Valve jobs, guides, pressure testing, hydro cleaning, resurfacing, CC chambers and port and polish. One reviewer has had LS cylinder heads overhauled here.
- Block clearance for strokers: Along with stroker clearancing, we handle block inspection, boring, decking, honing, sleeving, cam bearing install and final wash and assembly.
- Custom race and marine engines: Road race, sprint car, super stock, forced induction, nitrous, drag, pro street and marine builds.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get an estimate before you start?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we'll put together a free estimate for your engine work.

Q: Do you work on import engines?
A: Yes. We build a large number of import combinations, including Hondas, Subarus and Nissans.

Q: What payment do you take?
A: We take Visa, Mastercard, Discover, PayPal and Apple Pay.
